# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 and GPU APIs** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 advances to Skia m152 with Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and runtime safety fixes. It adds modern GPU capabilities while correcting ownership issues in image, region, pixmap, and runtime-effect paths.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — The release includes the m152 upstream renderer update and subsequent servicing corrections. ([#4505](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4505), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690))

## API Surface

- **Graphite and asynchronous pixel-read APIs** — New bindings expose Graphite backends and backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels operations on images and surfaces. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native object lifetime fixes** — Region iteration, pixmap subsets, raster image creation, and runtime-effect uniform resets correctly retain or release their native resources. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528), [#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515), [#4698](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4698), [#4714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4714))

## Platform

- **Vulkan support and native symbols strengthened** — The Vulkan Silk.NET package returns to production and native symbol packaging improves diagnostics on Apple and Android. ([#4499](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4499), [#4650](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4650), [#4694](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4694))
